name: LRCLIB Lyrics Provider
description: Official remote lyrics provider. Subscribes to lyrics.provider.query (search + download) backed by the keyless public LRCLIB API (lrclib.net). Synced (LRC) lyrics preferred, plain text as fallback.

permissions.reason: Receive track title/artist/album/duration for lyrics search; return lyric text for core to save as a sidecar.

configSchema.label: LRCLIB base URL
configSchema.helpText: Default https://lrclib.net (self-hosted LRCLIB mirrors work too).
